summary: Resolved seven #1111 overlap findings without merging proposition/source identities. (1) DEF-ACTUAL-ROOT names the exact NecessaryRootFork.ActualRoot shared by three scope-qualified views. (4) Arbitrary-frame Box is shared with the KB embedding; symmetry/domain/classical policies are separate commitments. Kant fixed-object NecessaryAt is exactly Box of that object’s existence, while NecessaryBeing has an actual witness; certified only that dictionary equality. (5) Reused #1141 DISAMB-MAXIME-ENS and calibrated/directedness bridges for generic respect r versus esse, preserving incomparable/tied/remainder controls and open source-to-old-I transfer. (6) JointGroups.Groups is a container, Exercise.suffices a member predicate; central sufficiency/deletion definition remains scenario-relative and may be vacuous without allowed scenarios. (7) Classification.disjoint is a proof projection, AbstractConcreteDisjoint a predicate constructor: a direct alias is ill-typed because construction already requires the proof. Certified exact predicate-preserving packaging instead; retained both APIs and avoided importing the causal wrapper into the foundational classification. No interpretation or philosophical premise is established. Findings and locators persist in the associated DEF/DISAMB records; no new source claims, primitive criteria, frame laws or frozen Challenge edits.
